BloodHound Q50: BloodHound Q50 was a rising Chicago rapper who became one of the most recognizable names connected to the BloodHound movement. Born in 2004, he began taking music seriously around 2023 and gained major attention through records like “Big 3,” “Splash Bros,” and collaborations with artists including BloodHound Lil Jeff, Lil Scoom89, and Rell Vert. His momentum eventually led to a record deal, and he continued building a growing fanbase before his passing in September 2026 at just 22 years old. 

Rell Vert is a Chicago rapper closely associated with the same circle of artists as Q50 and Lil Jeff. He was actually pursuing music seriously before some of the other artists around him, with Q50 once describing Rell Vert as the “meal ticket” of their circle because of how committed he was to making rap work. His catalog includes collaborations with Q50, Lil Jeff, and Lil Scoom89. 

Their Relationship: Q50 and Rell Vert were close friends and frequent collaborators who came up around the same Chicago rap circle. Their connection went beyond simply appearing on each other’s songs—Q50 publicly credited Rell Vert for being one of the people who took music seriously early on. Together they released tracks including “Bleed Red,” “GO” with Big Opp, and other collaborations, making Rell an important part of Q50’s musical story.
